question: Two conducting spheres of radii $R$ and $2R$ are charged to the same surface charge density $\sigma$. They are then connected by a conducting wire. Evaluate the direction of charge flow and the new equilibrium condition.

options.A: Charge flows from the larger sphere to the smaller sphere, and it stops when the potentials of the two spheres become equal.
options.B: Charge flows from the smaller sphere to the larger sphere, and it stops when the potentials of the two spheres become equal.
options.C: Charge flows from the larger sphere to the smaller sphere, and it stops when the surface charge densities of the two spheres become equal.
options.D: No charge flows because the initial surface charge densities are equal.
